name: DGME medical and dental college lists — Chattogram Division
organization: Directorate General of Medical Education (DGME), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
attribution: Source: Directorate General of Medical Education (dgme.gov.bd)
notes: Same DGME HTML tables as the Rajshahi, Rangpur and Dhaka runs: 'সরকারি/বেসরকারি মেডিকেল কলেজ' (college code, name, year established, MBBS seats; page updated 18 Dec 2025) and 'সরকারি/বেসরকারি ডেন্টাল কলেজ/ইউনিট' (updated 20 May 2024). Rows kept when the name's district suffix (or a district name in it) is in Chattogram Division. Dental units are attached to their parent medical college in extra_json. Army and Navy Medical Colleges (listed in the private table without a college code) are marked ownership 'armed_forces'. English names/websites for government colleges come from the 'সরকারী মেডিকেল কলেজ (সকল)' page (which spells 'Chattagram Medical College'), matched by district where the district has one government MBBS college. No addresses, phones or coordinates. Licence not stated.
